sourceChecks.note: Rolex's exact U.S. product page independently validates reference 124060, the current homogeneous Oystersteel/black-dial/Oyster-bracelet configuration, USD 10,050 retail price, 41 mm diameter, calibre 3230, approximately 70 hours, -2/+2 seconds per day, 300 m water resistance, sapphire crystal, Triplock screw-down crown, no date, and long-lasting blue Chromalight. Retrieved 2026-08-31.

Bob's Watches states that its thickness, lug-to-lug, and weight table is measured in-house from inventory. Its current-reference row for 124060 reports 12.5 mm thickness and 47.6 mm lug-to-lug. Its approximate 150 g value is not selected because a configuration-controlled full-link measurement is available. Retrieved 2026-08-31.

The 2026 exact-reference control matrix documents a 158.8 g owner-verified, full-link, factory-unworn 124060 on Oyster bracelet. The page explicitly distinguishes control configuration from universal authentication thresholds. Retrieved 2026-08-31.

Everest's exact fitment product names reference 124060, documents replacement spring bars that also fit the original Rolex bracelet, and states the late-2020 41 mm Submariner uses a 21 mm lug width. This resolves both the lug width and spring-bar interface. Retrieved 2026-08-31.
